blocks.text: Boxplots, jinhein whisker plots bhi kehte hain, median, quartiles (data ko chaar barabar hisson mein baantne wale points) aur possible outliers (baqi se bohat alag qeematein) dikha kar data ki distribution ki summary dete hain. Yeh data ki variability (phailao, qeematein kitni badalti hain) ki tasveer wali summary dete hain.
Misal: Boxplot se alag alag classes ke exam scores ka comparison kar ke dekh sakte hain ke overall (kul mila kar) kis class ne behtar kiya.

blocks.alt: Leta hua (horizontal) box plot, title Box Plot of Exam Scores for Three Classes, Exam Scores 50 se 100. Class 1: box taqreeban 62 se 75, median taqreeban 69, ek oonchi outlier. Class 2: box taqreeban 68 se 78, median taqreeban 73, do oonchi outliers. Class 3: box taqreeban 72 se 85, median taqreeban 77, ek neechi aur ek oonchi outlier.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.8: Teen classes ki performance dikhane wala boxplot (kitab ki Figure 5.8 jaisa hamara apna diagram).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har box beech ke aadhe students dikhata hai (pehle quartile se teesre quartile tak), laal line median hai, dashed lines (whiskers) baqi phailao aur chhote circles outliers. Class 3 ka median sab se ooncha hai, is liye us ki performance behtar hai; Class 3 ke whiskers bhi sab se lambe hain (taqreeban 57 se 98), yani us ke scores sab se zyada phaile hain. Class 2 ka box sab se patla hai, yani us ke beech wale scores sab se qareeb qareeb hain.

Yeh program boxplot ke numbers nikalta hai: minimum, Q1 (pehla quartile), median, Q3 (teesra quartile) aur maximum, aur outliers dhoondta hai. Quartile ke liye neeche aur oopar wale aadhe hisse ka median liya gaya hai, aur outlier ke liye aam rule 1.5 × IQR (Q3 − Q1). scores badal kar Run karein.

scores = [62, 65, 68, 69, 70, 72, 75, 74, 66, 95]

import statistics

data = sorted(scores)
half = len(data) // 2
q1 = statistics.median(data[:half])                   # median of lower half
med = statistics.median(data)
q3 = statistics.median(data[half + len(data) % 2:])   # median of upper half
iqr = q3 - q1
outliers = [x for x in data if x < q1 - 1.5 * iqr or x > q3 + 1.5 * iqr]

print("Sorted :", data)
print("Min =", data[0], " Q1 =", q1, " Median =", med, " Q3 =", q3, " Max =", data[-1])
print("Box (Q1 to Q3) width, IQR =", iqr)
print("Outliers:", outliers)
